I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant, and I especially want to recognize my server, Anna. She was extremely polite, patient, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout my meal.

When I thought I needed to dip the rice paper in water, she patiently explained that it was already soft and ready to use.

The food was delicious, but Anna’s service made the experience even better. She was warm, professional, patient, and attentive without being overbearing. Thank you, Anna, for making my meal such an enjoyable experience. I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
